```yaml
name: OpenMetadata Service Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci

  playwright-tests:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    env:
      PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_SHARD_COUNT: 5
      PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_SHARD_INDEX: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: microsoft/playwright-github-action@v1
        with:
          test-script: npm run test:e2e
          args: "-d postgresql -s true"
```
